Application Data.NAME: Premier Countertops LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Premier Countertops LLC specializes in high-quality residential and commercial countertop and surface installation services. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail, safety compliance, and use of premium materials including granite, quartz, marble, and engineered stone. Our team of experienced professionals handles all installations in-house, ensuring a consistent standard of workmanship. We adhere strictly to NFPA 101 (Life Safety Code) requirements, maintaining up-to-date fire safety measures in our operational premises. Additionally, we source our materials only from reputable suppliers to minimize risks related to material quality. Our commitment to safety and quality consistently leads to satisfied customers and a strong reputation in the industry.
